name: Aboleth Behemoth

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Mucus Haze
traits.details: any enemy treats the area within the aura as difficult terrain. While the aboleth is bloodied, enemies within the aura take a –2 penalty to saving throws against dazed and dominated effects.

traits.name: Persistent Grab
traits.details: An aboleth behemoth can sustain a grab on all creatures it is currently grabbing with a single minor action.

traits.name: Threatening Reach
traits.details: An aboleth behemoth can make opportunity attacks against any enemy within 3 squares of it.

auras.name: Mucus Haze
auras.details: any enemy treats the area within the aura as difficult terrain. While the aboleth is bloodied, enemies within the aura take a –2 penalty to saving throws against dazed and dominated effects.

hit.description: damage, and the target is grabbed and dazed (save ends)

effect.description: The aboleth behemoth makes two tentacle attacks, each against different targets
The aboleth behemoth makes three tentacle attacks, each against different targets

hit.description: damage, and the aboleth behemoth slides the target 3 squares

powers.name: Mind Bore
powers.trigger: when the aboleth damages a dazed or dominated target with a tentacle attack

effect.description: The triggering attack deals ongoing 10 psychic damage to the target (save ends).
